name: Stranglethorn Fever
summary: In Booty Bay, Fin Fizracket grows weaker with Stranglethorn Fever. He believes he is dying and says only Mokk the Savage's heart can cure him.

sections.title: A Desperate Cure
sections.body: Fin Fizracket stammers as his strength fails. Certain he has caught Stranglethorn Fever, he says he must eat the heart of Mokk the Savage to be cured. Mokk is an elusive white beast, and only Witch Doctor Unbagwa can summon him. Fin sends you to find Unbagwa in the Spirit Den, a hidden cave on the southern cape.

sections.title: Back at Fin's Side
sections.body: After Fin receives Mokk's heart, his strength begins to return. He wakes unsure where he is, then learns he is in Booty Bay and speaks of a strange dream. Yet some of his weakness remains.

faq.q: What illness is Fin Fizracket suffering from?
faq.answer: Fin says he has Stranglethorn Fever, a deadly virus that leaves him cold and delirious. He believes he is dying.

faq.q: What is required to cure the fever?
faq.answer: Fin says he must eat the heart of Mokk the Savage, an elusive white beast, to be cured.
Witch Doctor Unbagwa alone can summon Mokk the Savage. He is in the Spirit Den, a hidden cave on the southern cape in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Where can Fin Fizracket be found?
faq.answer: Fin Fizracket is in Booty Bay.
